external_coverage.exact_statement: BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1 uses finite globally embedded rational complexes, assumes purity, sets N_sigma=N intersect span_R(sigma−sigma), and uses inward primitive facet-quotient lifts, rational balancing weights modulo facet tangents, and strictly positive top cycles (Definitions 2.1–2.4, 2.18–2.27; Remark 2.5).

BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1 PCCs have rational endpoints, arbitrary real nonnegative coefficients summing to one, center x=sum_i alpha_i x_i, and faces tau≤sigma_i containing x and x_i on some rational structure. Definition 3.3 imposes Jensen inequalities without explicitly requiring continuity (Definitions 3.2–3.3).

BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1 defines literal PA by continuity, integral slopes and rational constants; PAPC by nonnegative divisors; PCreg by uniform reference-bounded PAPC approximation; and raw MA by f^d·[X] using divisor formula (2.32) (Definitions 2.28–2.31, 3.1, 3.14, 3.20, 3.23, 4.4).
BMPS arXiv:2603.08664v1 defines its compactification as closure in a tropical toric space with quotient-vector-space strata, rather than closure inside N_R (Definition 2.13).

accepted_partial_scope: Finite globally embedded pure positive balanced rational complexes have Euclidean stationarity with weights w_sigma*covol(N_sigma), hence no nonempty compact positive-dimensional support. The convex cone of a finite positive balanced fan equals its linear span and admits strictly positive rational relations on all chosen generators. Continuous rational-endpoint PC functions obey a componentwise maximum principle in precise balanced local charts; compact connected continuous competitors are constants. A finite bounded rational cell decomposition yields a rational constant literal-PA envelope with zero positive-dimensional raw divisor/contact; finite dimension-zero spaces retain the zero-fold weighted cycle and have zero gap. Printed rational-endpoint Jensen inequalities alone admit f=0 on Q and -1 off Q, contradicting automatic continuity. No unrestricted competitor or noncompact classification closure.
residual_original_gaps: Noncompact higher-dimensional real regularity/contact, operator-domain identification for unrestricted competitors, and necessary-and-sufficient original P05.1/P05.2 structural classification remain open.
